caption: A 7-segment display decoder: four input lines (a 4-bit number) light the seven segments of its hex digit, 0-9 then A b C d E F, 649 blocks in a 9x9 tower. Seven rings stacked every 2 levels, one per segment: four subtract comparators face the segment's lamp; each compares one row of the top two bits (its two sides read a3 and a2, or their inverses, from the ring's corners) with that row's function of the low two bits (its rear). Torch towers carry the inputs up the corners; each rear column is a torch chain (the inverse of the rear two levels down) plus injected a1/a0 terms. Catalog parts: comparator gates and torch inverters.
